items.title: Unit 3 · Story
items.prompt: Listen and choose the word.
items.storyText: Hi, I'm Fran. In winter, my class takes a big test. Then we go on vacation! We play outside in the snow. Some kids are fast on their skates. My friend and I smile. We make hot tea and stir it with a spoon. In summer, we play outside in the sun! We swim in the lake and go on the swings. I like the winter and the summer. What season do you like?
items.why: In “Seasons”, you hear: My friend and I smile. The missing word is “smile”.
items.hint: Listen to this sentence again. Look at the story picture.
items.sourceLabel: Oxford Phonics World 4, Unit 3, p.31 · Titi narration of the supplied textbook text
